items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: Raymond knows that tune. ... Raymond played that all the time. And I liked it too. Because Raymond heard it too when Rene played it.

ctx.x: What tunes do you feature now that are sort of forgotten to most bands? Like Avalian Scots. I don't know anybody else but you and Raymond and I guess Paul.
That's right. Raymond knows that tune.
Down under beneath of Hawaii and Scotland.
